name: Month end: payroll, then suppliers
description: Runs payroll with the Run payroll template, then pays the month's suppliers with the Pay a list template, then tells the owner how both went in one message.

steps.name: Tell the owner how the month went

input.title: ='Month end ' + steps.payroll.output.period
input.message: ='Payroll: ' + string(steps.payroll.output.paid) + ' staff paid (NGN ' + string(steps.payroll.output.paid_naira) + '). Suppliers: ' + string(steps.suppliers.output.paid) + ' paid (NGN ' + string(steps.suppliers.output.paid_naira) + ').'
